title: Currents of degree exceeding the ambient dimension vanish
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with P < n, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set and let X ∈ D_n(U) (a GeometricCurrentOn U n). Then X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n), P < n → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, X ω = 0
